ImpactRequest.description: The input of impact. Downstream takes dead, dead_links or site_failure; upstream takes target_object_id.

direction.description: downstream (default) asks what a failure reaches; upstream asks what the target depends on.

dead.description: The objects that have failed (downstream). At most 1000.

items.description: An object id, obj_ and 32 hex digits.

dead_links.description: Links that are cut (downstream). The objects at their ends do not fail; what depends on the link loses it. At most 1000.

items.description: A link id, lnk_ and 32 hex digits.

site_failure.description: Objects that fail with everything that is contained in them (downstream). At most 1000.

items.description: An object id, obj_ and 32 hex digits.

dead_scope_id.description: A stored scope; not served yet, the answer is a refusal.

target_object_id.description: The object whose dependencies are listed (upstream).

mode.description: both (default), facts_only or with_assumptions: which readings of the evidence are answered.

max_hops.description: Stop the spread after this many rounds; 0 or absent means no limit.

max_items.description: Keep at most this many items of each reading; default 5000, at most 100000.

time_budget.description: Stop the calculation after this time, an ISO 8601 duration; default PT30S.

kg_version_id.description: Read this sealed KG version (time travel).

change_seq.description: Read the state at this change number (time travel).

min_seq.description: Wait until this change number is readable.

wait_timeout.description: How long to wait for min_seq, an ISO 8601 duration such as PT5S.

max_staleness.description: Refuse values older than this, an ISO 8601 duration.

limit.description: The page size; default 100, at most 1000.

cursor.description: The cursor of the previous page.

PathLink.description: The link that carried a failure on to the next object of a path.

link_id.description: The link id, lnk_ and 32 hex digits.

meaning.description: The meaning of the link type.

role.description: How the failure went on: dependency, supply, management, group_member, failover, part_follows_whole, whole_needs_part, containment, exposure or group_slack.

delay_class.description: delayed when the link says the effect comes later.

note.description: A note, such as what min_alive of a group stands on.

PathStep.description: One object of a path. The first step is the object that failed; the others say how the failure reached them.

object_id.description: The object id; null when the caller may not read the object.

hidden.description: Whether the object is hidden from the caller.

ParentCount.description: How many affected objects are contained in one place.

object_id.description: The object id of the place.

display_name.description: The display name of the place.

GroupTouched.description: A redundancy group whose members were hit.

group_id.description: The object id of the group.

unknown.description: Members whose state is not known.

min_alive.description: The least number of members that must be up; null when it is not known.

slack.description: Members up above min_alive; null when min_alive is not known or the group is not up.

result.description: The most severe result: down, interrupted, unknown, exposed_direct, exposed_inherited, degraded or unmanageable.

also.description: The other results of the object.

lost_channels.description: What the object lost: power, cooling, network, storage, service or management.

unfilled_channels.description: Channels the type needs that no link supplies; they say nothing about this failure.

delay_class.description: delayed when a link on the path says the effect comes later.

via.description: The object just before this one on the path; null when it is the seed.

via_hidden.description: Whether that object is hidden from the caller.

hops.description: How many links from the failed object.

assumption_based.description: Whether the path stands on a link or a min_alive that is assumed.

weakest_grade.description: The lowest grade on the path.

path.description: From the failed object to this one.

ImpactSection.description: The answer of one reading: the counts first, then the items.

counts_by_result.description: How many objects have each result.

counts_by_type.description: How many objects of each type.

counts_by_parent.description: The places the affected objects are contained in, the most affected first.

groups_touched.description: The groups whose members were hit.

unfilled_channel_objects.description: How many affected objects have a channel that no link supplies.

items.description: The affected objects of this page, the most severe first; absent in the summary shape.

UpstreamItem.description: One object the target depends on, with what happens to the target when that object alone fails.

hops.description: How many dependencies between it and the target.

effects.description: The result for the target in each reading (none when nothing happens).

single_point_of_failure.description: Whether the target goes down when this object alone fails.

assumption_based.description: Whether the answer stands on an assumption.

path.description: From this object to the target.

UpstreamSection.description: What the target depends on: the counts first, then the items.

single_points_of_failure.description: How many of them take the target down alone.

counts_by_type.description: How many dependencies of each type.

counts_by_effect.description: How many dependencies have each effect.

items.description: The dependencies of this page, single points of failure first; absent in the summary shape.

ImpactComputation.description: Whether the calculation ran to its end and what limited it.

complete.description: Whether it ran to its end.

stopped_by.description: time_budget or max_hops when a limit stopped it.

rounds.description: How many rounds the failure spread.

max_hops.description: The max_hops of the question; 0 means no limit.

weak_links.description: How many links are not believed in the facts.

stale_inputs.description: How many observed links are older than max_staleness.

items_over_cap.description: Whether a reading had more items than max_items.

seeds.description: The objects that were made to fail (downstream).
